basis: Natural=H259 first32 state PCs. Source=top32 of mean normalized-source-displacement outer products, training actual full edits all9 heads, uncentered. Residual_jacobian=top32 of sampled E[J_E(x).T J_E(x)] for native-minus-compiled polynomial E on normalized input x;8 Gaussian output probes per training site, exact pullbacks, no RMS derivative because x is feature input. No validation/test basis fitting. Linear624 state PCs fixed across all. Products528, readout1152+intercept identical; other bases can add32 input reads outside linear span, so total read span not guaranteed equal.

gates.source_basis_gain: Source basis exceeds natural selected actual test response fidelity by>=.05 at BOTH scales, paired document-bootstrap95 lower bound>0.
gates.jacobian_basis_gain: Residual Jacobian basis meets same criterion.
gates.half_response: Jacobian selected fidelity>=.50 at BOTH actual scales.

scope: Same768 response train/256 validation and reused128 test. All heads supervised. Fixed equal readout coefficient count, explicit basis-construction/read-span caveat. MC gradient covariance is not exact tensor decomposition or semantic labeling. All18 ridge candidates retained; validation selects alpha per basis, no winning basis selected.
